title: Fate's Crossroads
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing grasped Chen Ji's ice-cold hand, her voice tender: "Perhaps there is a third path—before you decide, let me tell you the true secret of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path."

text.content:
The entrance to the sealing space slowly cracked open before Chen Ji, streams of ghostly blue light pouring from the fissure, like opening a gate to the underworld. He stood rooted to the spot, his Adam's apple bobbing slightly—the warning from the Heavenly Eye still echoed in his mind, that phrase "The day the shackles are removed is when death descends" like a sword suspended above his head, ready to fall at any moment. What did Mo Xiansheng mean by "death can also be another door"? He took a deep breath and stepped into the ghostly light. Whatever the answer, he had to see it with his own eyes.

The moment he stepped into the sealing space, biting cold assaulted him. This space was unlike any secret realm he had ever seen—around him were flowing points of light like stardust, beneath his feet was an endless abyss, and not far ahead, a figure wrapped in layers of chains floated motionless in mid-air. The figure was slender, with hair like a cascading waterfall, and though its face was obscured by a hazy glow, that silhouette—Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. It was his sister, the one he had searched through three scrolls, the one he believed had long died in the Holy Sect's hands. Chen Nian.

His legs felt like they were filled with lead, each step weighing a thousand pounds. Those chains binding her were not ordinary material, but woven from countless tiny runes, each rune emitting faint Heavenly Fate power. So that's how it is. Heavenly Fate Key. He murmured to himself, his voice hoarse, almost unrecognizable. His sister was never a prisoner of the Holy Sect, but their tool, a key to maintaining some kind of balance.

The stardust points of light within the sealing space seemed to sense Chen Ji's presence, beginning to slowly gather and condense into a blurry vision before him. In the vision, Chen Nian's body was connected to the core of Tianqing Sect's spiritual veins—her heartbeat synchronized with the pulse of the spiritual veins, her breath resonating with the flow of天地 spiritual energy. The Holy Sect took her not to use her, but to place her here as the "anchor point" maintaining the fate balance of this continent.

Once this anchor was removed, the shackles of fate would indeed be lifted, but Chen Nian, as the "key," would be judged by the Heavenly Will as "superfluous" and immediately erased. Chen Ji's fingers dug deep into his palm, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he felt nothing. Mo Xiansheng's words echoed in his ears—death can also be another door. Must he trade his sister's life for freedom? Is the so-called "third path" merely a cruel joke?

Just then, a gentle voice came from behind him: "Chen Ji." Ye Qing had somehow followed him in; her unique cold aura of a Demonic Path Saint carried a hint of careful tenderness at this moment. Looking at Chen Ji's rigid back, something deep within her was profoundly moved—this man renowned for his flawless calculations, his back now appeared so fragile. She softly said: "I saw it... you were crying."

dialogue.content: You don't have to bear it alone.

text.content:
Ye Qing walked closer, her footsteps so light they made almost no sound, yet in this silent space they seemed especially clear. This was the first time she had seen Chen Ji lose control like this—that man who was always calm and effortlessly strategic, his eyes now red-rimmed, fists clenched so tight his knuckles had turned from strain. Had he always been alone? Bearing all this by himself, facing the碾压 of Heavenly Will alone, struggling to survive in the crevices of fate alone. An inexplicable emotion rose in Ye Qing's heart, like heartache, like a sense of shared suffering.

She grew up in the Holy Sect, trained as a tool from childhood, never experiencing the warmth of family affection. But now, watching Chen Ji's slightly trembling shoulders, she suddenly understood—even this seemingly cold man had softness deep in his heart that could not be severed. She said nothing, simply standing quietly by his side, like a silent barrier, separating him from part of this cruel world's malice. The stardust points of light within the sealing space flowed around the two of them, reflecting two leaning silhouettes.

Chen Ji sensed Ye Qing's presence but did not turn around. He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, trying to suppress the churning emotions. But those images came crashing like a tide—his childhood with his sister in a dilapidated thatched cottage, the small figure that pushed him away when the Holy Sect attacked, and countless midnight dreams of his sister's blurred face. He thought he had long buried that softness, yet at this moment discovered it had never disappeared, merely been hidden deep in the most secret corner of his heart.

"Ye Qing." His voice was hoarse, carrying a vulnerability never heard before, "If... if her life must be traded for all this, what should I do?" This question seemed squeezed from the depths of his chest, trembling, confused, even with a hint of supplication he himself despised. This was the first time he displayed such obvious weakness before anyone, the first time he admitted there were things beyond his power.

dialogue.content: But I know, in the eyes of the Holy Sect, I'm just a tool that can be replaced at any time.

text.content:
Ye Qing's voice was soft, yet carried a heart-shattering calm. She continued: "From the moment I was born, I was trained to be a chess piece of the Holy Sect. My joys and sorrows, my dreams and hopes—all were unimportant. What mattered was whether the bloodline in me could be exploited by them." Her gaze fell on that figure bound by chains, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes, "Your sister... in the eyes of the Holy Sect, is probably the same."

She turned around, meeting Chen Ji's eyes for the first time. Those eyes that should have been alluring and enchanting were now clear as mountain spring water, carrying an unprecedented seriousness. "But you're different. You've never treated her as a tool. You've searched for her all this time, not to use her, but because she's your sister." Her voice trembled slightly, "This feeling... perhaps is part of the answer."

Just then, a low rumble came from the depths of the sealing space. Those chains binding Chen Nian suddenly began to shake violently, countless runes flickering frantically, the Heavenly Fate power they emitted now more than ten times stronger than before. At the same time, a familiar voice rang in Chen Ji's mind—it was Mo Xiansheng's voice, with a hint of urgency: "Chen Ji, the sealing space has detected an external intrusion. The will of the Heavenly Eye is accelerating its erosion of your remaining time. You must make your choice now, otherwise—"

Before the words finished, a crack spread across the chains surrounding Chen Nian. The light seeping through that crack was not ghostly blue, but dazzling gold-red, a sign of Heavenly Power run amok. Chen Ji's face instantly turned ashen—if the chains collapsed completely, his sister would die; but if he didn't make a choice, the Heavenly Eye would forcibly intervene, and the situation would only worsen.

choice.prompt: The sealing space begins to collapse, Chen Ji must make a choice within the limited time.

choices.text: Sacrifice his sister, remove the shackles
choices.description: Accept the Heavenly Eye's terms, trading Chen Nian's sacrifice for the removal of fate's shackles. This is the smallest cost, but also the choice Chen Ji cannot accept.
choices.visible_reward: Shackles removed, Heavenly Fate stops depleting
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji will forever lose his only relative, and may fall into irreversible dark corruption

text.content: Chen Ji's hand trembled as he raised it, pointing toward that figure bound by chains. His lips moved, but no sound emerged. "No—" This word squeezed from his throat, carrying tearing pain. Just as his hand was about to touch the key rune to release the seal, an ice-cold hand suddenly grasped his wrist.

choices.text: Refuse to choose, seek the third path
choices.description: Believe Mo Xiansheng's words that death can also be another door. Refuse to accept this either-or dilemma, attempt to find a third possibility in the desperate situation.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heavenly Eye, facing more severe backlash
choices.risk_hint: Under the pressure of the sealing space collapsing, this choice may bring fatal consequences

text.content: "No." Chen Ji's voice suddenly became firm, he violently shook off Ye Qing's hand, his eyes burning with a certain resolute light. "I refuse. I don't believe this world has only one road to death." His voice echoed within the sealing space, carrying a near-mad stubbornness.

choices.text: Ask Ye Qing for help, inquire about the secrets of the Demonic Path
choices.description: As the Holy Sect's Saint, Ye Qing might have deeper knowledge of the Holy Sect's secrets. Perhaps she knows some inside information about the Heavenly Fate Lock Key that could help Chen Ji find the third path.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his attachment to his sister might be exploited by Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Might obtain crucial information and find the third path
choices.risk_hint: Trusting a demonic path cultivator carries risks, but Ye Qing seems to have no ill intentions

text.content: Chen Ji turned sharply to Ye Qing, a flicker of hope in his eyes. "You're the Holy Sect's Saint, you lived in the Holy Sect for so many years..." His voice was urgent, yet retained some composure. "Do you know anything about the true secret of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key?"

Ye Qing felt her heart skip a beat under Chen Ji's expectant gaze. It was the first time she'd seen such a clear plea in this man's eyes—not scheming, not plotting, but genuinely asking for her help. Her heart surged with warmth, yet also carried a trace of bitterness—so he could trust someone so completely.

"I..." She hesitated, her mind racing through fragments of words she'd ignored during her time in the Holy Sect. "I remember the Saint's inheritance mentioned that there isn't just one Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Her voice carried uncertainty. "The Holy Sect made a deal with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, using multiple 'keys' to spread the risk. If your sister is one of them, then theoretically... there should be a way to replace her from that position."

Her words sparked a glimmer in Chen Ji's eyes. Replace. Mo Xiansheng had said something similar—death could also be another door. Could the "third door" be finding another key to replace Chen Nian? But where would one find another "Heavenly Fate Lock Key"? And who would be willing to make such a sacrifice?

dialogue.content: During the Saint's inheritance ceremony, another person was chosen as a 'spare lock key'... That person fled midway through the ceremony. The Holy Sect pursued him for a long time, but in the end, the matter was dropped.

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart suddenly raced. A faint clue emerged in his mind—the spare lock key. If Ye Qing was telling the truth, this escaped "spare" was likely still alive and possessed key secrets about the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. He began rapidly searching through his memories, the fragments of the Tianji Record flashing frantically as countless images flickered past like a carousel.

Suddenly, a blurred image froze before his eyes. Years ago, on a rainy night, while hiding from pursuers in a remote town, he'd encountered a strange old beggar. The moment the beggar saw him, terror flickered in his eyes, muttering words like "So it's you" before fleeing in panic. He'd paid it no mind then, but now he recalled—the old beggar's age, build, and that desperate air of being hunted all matched Ye Qing's description of the "spare lock key."

He'd found his direction.

choice.prompt: A clue has emerged, Chen Ji must decide on the next move.

choices.text: Immediately track down the old beggar's whereabouts
choices.description: Since there's a lead, action should be taken immediately. With the Tianji Record's foresight ability, perhaps the old beggar's location can be locked onto in a short time.
choices.visible_cost: The sealing space could collapse at any moment, his sister's condition is unstable
choices.visible_reward: Might find the spare lock key, thus finding the third path
choices.risk_hint: Leaving the sealing space means temporarily abandoning his sister, possibly missing the best timing for rescue

text.content: "I must leave here." Chen Ji's voice regained composure, but the anxiety in his eyes couldn't be hidden. He turned to Chen Nian suspended in mid-air, took a deep breath, "Wait for me, I will definitely come back to save you." He activated the Tianji Record's foresight ability and began searching for traces of the old beggar.

choices.text: Stay in the sealing space to reinforce the protection
choices.description: Give up tracking the lead, first try to stabilize his sister's condition. At least ensure that before finding a solution, she won't die from the seal's collapse.
choices.visible_cost: Might miss the best timing to find the spare lock key
choices.visible_reward: Buy more time for his sister, reduce immediate risk
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao might take advantage of the opening, reinforcing protection may not necessarily stop it

text.content: "No, I cannot leave just like that." Chen Ji shook his head, his gaze firmly set on those flickering chains. He began mobilizing the spiritual energy within his body, attempting to construct a new layer of protection within the sealing space. "My sister has waited for so many years, a few more days won't matter. Before I find the spare lock key, I must ensure she stays alive at least."

Chen Ji began channeling the spiritual energy within his body, forming a complex seal with both hands. Streams of golden light flowed from his fingertips, merging into those chains on the verge of collapse. This was an extremely taxing process—soon, fine beads of sweat appeared on his forehead, his complexion growing paler by the moment. Yet he gritted his teeth and persevered.

Watching from the side, Ye Qing's heart churned with mixed emotions. She stepped forward, withdrawing a jet-black jade pendant from her sleeve and gently pressing it against Chen Ji's back. A wave of cool energy instantly surged into his body—that was the demonic path's unique "Mist-Concealing Power," capable of temporarily shielding against the perception of Heavenly Dao's will. "This is my only keepsake for survival," her voice was soft, "Now I'll lend it to you."

Chen Ji felt that surge of power, his body trembling slightly. He turned his head, meeting Ye Qing's eyes, and for the first time noticed that even this demonic path Saint's eyes held such profound tenderness. He wanted to say something, but found his throat blocked as if by something.

dialogue.content: Don't misunderstand, I just don't want to owe you a favor.

text.content:
Ye Qing turned her face away, her ears flushing a faint red. She claimed indifference, yet her trembling hands betrayed her true emotions. Chen Ji observed this display of poorly concealed feelings, feeling something within him unexpectedly soften. This demonic path Saint was entirely different from what he'd imagined.

Through their combined efforts, the sealing space's collapse finally slowed. The chains on the verge of snapping stabilized once more, and the flickering runes returned to their normal rhythm. Chen Nian's suspended form seemed to sense something—the face obscured by the halo turned slightly toward Chen Ji, her lips curving into an almost imperceptible smile.

"She smiled," Ye Qing whispered, a note of wonder in her voice. Chen Ji stared at that faint smile, his eyes reddening once more. Sister, wait for me. Whatever the cost, I will rescue you. He clenched his fists, a decision crystallizing in his heart.

choice.prompt: The seal is temporarily stabilized, and Chen Ji faces his final choice.

choices.text: Making a promise, he walks the path alone.
choices.description: Promising Ye Qing he would return, he embarked alone on the journey to find the replacement lock-key. This was the path he knew best—walking alone through the darkness, weaving hope for those he loved.
choices.visible_cost: He must face all dangers alone.
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining an air of mystery, making Ye Qing even more curious about him.
choices.risk_hint: Traveling alone carries tremendous risks, and Ye Qing might have her own ideas.

text.content: Chen Ji turned to Ye Qing, his deep eyes shimmering with a complex light. He reached out, gently clasping the hand holding the jade pendant, and murmured softly: "Wait for me to return." Just three simple words, yet they seemed to carry the weight of a thousand tons.

choices.text: Inviting Ye Qing to accompany him.
choices.description: Since Ye Qing knew so much about the Holy Sect's secrets, why not invite her to join the journey to find the replacement lock-key? This way they could look after each other and further deepen their understanding of one another.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his vulnerabilities, letting Ye Qing fully understand his purpose.
choices.visible_reward: Gaining a reliable companion, so the journey would no longer be lonely.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing was after all from the Demonic Path, bringing her into his plans carried certain risks.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then made a decision that even surprised himself. "Come with me." He looked at Ye Qing, his voice calm yet carrying a hint of unprecedented warmth. "Your help is very important to me."

Ye Qing froze. She gazed into Chen Ji's eyes—inside them there was no scheming, no probing, only a kind of frankness she had never seen in this man before. This strategist who orchestrated the world actually invited her to travel together? Her heart raced uncontrollably, and some emotion she had thought long dead was quietly reviving in her heart.

"You..." She opened her mouth, only to find her voice somewhat hoarse. During her years at the Holy Sect, she had seen too many hollow promises and cruel betrayals, and no longer believed in anyone. But now, looking into Chen Ji's sincere eyes, her emotional defenses cracked for the first time. She took a deep breath, striving to keep her voice steady: "The pursuers from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path will never let me go—following you might bring you trouble."

Even so, she did not say "no." Chen Ji noticed this, and a faint smile curved his lips. "In all these years of orchestrating the world, do you think I'm afraid of a few pursuers?" His tone carried a hint of confidence. "Besides, your 'Demonic Mist' can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record—it is invaluable to me." He paused, his voice softening: "This is not exploitation, it is cooperation."

Ye Qing's voice was soft, yet carried an unprecedented firmness. She lifted her head, meeting Chen Ji's gaze directly. Those eyes, once enchanting, were now clear as mountain spring water. "Chen Ji, I remember every word you said today." A faint smile curved her lips. "If you dare deceive me, I swear—even at the cost of my very soul—I will make you pay."

This was a threat, and also a promise. Chen Ji looked at this demon sect saint feigning fierceness before him, and warmth surged in his heart. He reached out, gently stroking her hair, as if caring for a younger sister who needed protection. "Rest assured, I never deceive," his voice low and gentle. "Especially those willing to trust me."

Outside the seal's space, dusk was approaching. The setting sun's afterglow bathed the two of them, stretching their shadows long across the ground. Chen Ji cast one final glance at his sister suspended in the depths of the space, and silently swore in his heart: Wait for me, Nian. This time, it is my turn to protect you.

He turned and stepped out of the seal's space shoulder to shoulder with Ye Qing. The gears of fate turned once more, and this time, he was no longer alone.
